deadline.value: Apply by December 1 for full consideration, and no PhD applications after April 30, but the page gives no year.
deadline.quote: Apply by December 1 for full consideration.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required for any applicant.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required for any applicant.

gre_subject.value: No GRE subject test is needed, because GRE scores are not required.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not required for any applicant.

fee_waiver.value: A faculty member who wants to recruit an applicant can request an application-fee waiver in cases of extreme need; applicants cannot ask directly.
fee_waiver.quote: In cases of extreme need, an individual faculty member can request a waiver of the application fee for a prospective student they intend to recruit.

supervisor.value: No M.S. or PhD student is admitted without a research advisor willing to mentor them.
supervisor.quote: No M.S. or Ph.D. student will be admitted without a research advisor willing to mentor them

funding.value: Every student may apply for research or teaching assistantships, but the page says these are very competitive.

entry_route.value: A relevant bachelor's or master's degree is required, so either route can apply.
entry_route.quote: Admission requires a relevant bachelor's or master's degree.

notes: Materials Science is a joint program across Engineering, Science and Forestry; applicants name potential advisors on the application.
